decision.reason: All complete repeat calls pass independent energy/triples/force/residual gates; primitive work and public counters/caps are preserved, native budget/slot tests and memcheck pass. Paired timing observations and limitations are retained separately.

reproduction.instructions: Apply source.patch to revision. Build CUDA 12.9 sm_120 Release with explicit CXX/CUDA ccache launchers, checkout-root CCACHE_BASEDIR and fast_compile=false. Use a finite main Slurm allocation (gpu:5090:1 on n1, gpu:pro6000:1 on n2), preserve assigned CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Set GENERATIVEQC_LIBRARY, PYTHONPATH=python:., CPU thread limits=1 and a fresh GENERATIVEQC_DF_PROGRESS_TRACE path. Alternate parent/candidate libraries in six AB/BA process pairs for --atoms 6 and 12, retaining all four calls. Build/run test_mp2_cuda_status with GENERATIVEQC_MP2_CUDA_TEST=1; --eri-batches-only skips its intentional CUDA OOM probe for compute-sanitizer. The full 14-AO endpoint is separately memchecked.
